name: xwz-car-parking-system
description: Microservices scaffold for the XWZ Car Parking Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix api-gateway run dev" "npm --prefix auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix parking-service run dev" "npm --prefix entry-service run dev" "npm --prefix billing-service run dev" "npm --prefix reporting-service run dev"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently "npm --prefix api-gateway run dev" "npm --prefix auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix parking-service run dev" "npm --prefix entry-service run dev" "npm --prefix billing-service run dev" "npm --prefix reporting-service run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm --prefix api-gateway run start" "npm --prefix auth-service run start" "npm --prefix parking-service run start" "npm --prefix entry-service run start" "npm --prefix billing-service run start" "npm --prefix reporting-service run start"
